datasets.name: Global Landslide Catalog database
datasets.source: NASA (Kirschbaum et al., 2010; Kirschbaum et al., 2015)
datasets.verbatim: The location of the landslide scars was based on the coordinates of past landslide events, which were made available in the Global Landslide Catalog database (Kirschbaum et al., 2015).

datasets.name: Landsat-8 satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: For the stages involving the training and assessment of the neural network, scenes from the Landsat-8 satellite were used, encompassing the region of Nepal (Bragagnolo et al., 2020b).

methods.name: U-Net
methods.summary: A U-Net architecture implemented in Keras/TensorFlow, trained on Landsat-8 imagery to perform semantic segmentation of landslide scars. The model uses a contraction path for feature extraction and an expansion path for spatial reconstruction, trained with a weighted binary crossentropy and dice loss function to handle class imbalance.
methods.source: L. Bragagnolo, L.R. Rezende, R.V. da Silva, J.M.V. Grzybowski
methods.verbatim: e manner, this work was dedicated to test the applicability and effectiveness of a u-net for semantic segmentation of satellite imagery
